title: CloudWatch Alarm Does Not Trigger Action
symptom: CloudWatch metric breached threshold, but no SNS email was sent and alarm remains in INSUFFICIENT_DATA or OK.
initial_observations: Alarm history shows no state transition to ALARM.
environment: AWS CloudWatch Alarm with SNS topic subscription.

possible_causes.cause: Alarm metric dimension mismatch (e.g. alarm configured for different instance ID or dimension)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Metric dimensions in alarm definition do not match emitted metric dimensions.
possible_causes.remediation: Update alarm dimensions to match exact metric namespace and dimension key-values.

possible_causes.cause: Actions only trigger on state TRANSITIONS (OK -> ALARM); alarm was already in ALARM
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Alarm history shows no new state transition occurred during breach.
possible_causes.remediation: Acknowledge that CloudWatch alarms notify only when state changes, not on each evaluation period.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Alarm Evaluation History
investigation_steps.explanation: Review timestamps of every state evaluation and action execution.

verification: Alarm history records successful execution of SNS publish action on state change.
prevention: Set appropriate 'Treat missing data as' policy (e.g. treat as breaching for availability alarms).
